headline: Seoul High Court Upholds Acquittal Of Kakao Founder Kim Beom-Su
seoTitle: Kim Beom-Su Acquittal Upheld in SM Stock Case
metaDescription: The Seoul High Court has upheld the acquittal of Kakao founder Kim Beom-su regarding allegations of stock price manipulation during a 2023 takeover battle.
aiSummaryBullets: The Seoul High Court confirmed the acquittal of Kakao founder Kim Beom-su on charges of stock price manipulation.
Prosecutors alleged Kim manipulated SM Entertainment share prices to win a takeover battle against Hybe in 2023.
The court determined that prosecutors failed to demonstrate sufficient intent or evidence of illegal market rigging.
aiContextParagraph: The legal dispute centers on Kakao Corp's 2023 acquisition of the K-pop agency SM Entertainment. During the takeover process, Kakao faced competition from Hybe, which initiated a tender offer for SM shares. Prosecutors charged Kim Beom-su with violating the Capital Market Act, alleging that the company intentionally inflated SM share prices above Hybe's tender offer price through systematic, large-scale purchases in February 2023. Kim, the founder of the major South Korean technology conglomerate, has maintained his innocence throughout the three-year investigation. Following the initial acquittal by a lower court, the appellate court decision serves to reinforce the finding that insufficient evidence existed to prove criminal intent to manipulate the stock market. Kim stated that the ruling concludes a period of significant uncertainty for the firm. Former Kakao executive Bae Jae-hyun was also involved in the broader legal proceedings surrounding the acquisition.
whyItIsViral: The story is being covered by two independent news outlets, reflecting significant interest in the legal standing of a major technology leader.
